continuity: Taekyung and the Fire Dragon Pavilion are heading west toward Xinjiang in response to unprecedented Dark Heaven activity.
More than thirty Hidden Shadow Pavilion agents are reported dead, and contact ended after their first and last messenger eagle; enemy numbers may exceed a hundred thousand.
Taekyung judges Dark Heaven’s followers to be far stronger and more dangerous than the Demonic Cult’s forces of fifty years ago.
Taekyung’s decision to head west triggers a new Quest alert; its objective is not established in this chapter.
Taekyung still cannot Logout and wonders whether the restriction is connected to the events in Xinjiang, but has no confirmation.
plot: After speaking privately with Jin Wikyung, Taekyung gathers the Fire Dragon Pavilion and reveals that unprecedented activity is underway in Xinjiang, now Dark Heaven’s stronghold. The Hidden Shadow Pavilion lost more than thirty elite agents, and their last messenger eagle carried the final contact; the enemy may number more than a hundred thousand and is said to be far more powerful than the Demonic Cult’s forces of fifty years ago.
Taekyung recalls Jeok Cheongang’s account that the Demonic Cult arose around the same time as Shaolin, then decides that the group will head west. A new Quest alert sounds.
translation_decisions: Render 십만마도 as “Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples” in Namho’s estimate.

active_continuity: Taekyung has fully opened his Middle Dantian, reached the Supreme Peak realm, completed Bone Transformation, and absorbed internal energy passed on by the Heavenly Power Demon and Peng Cheolhu.
Taekyung is resolved to help bring about the peace the dead wanted and aspires to reach the upper dantian.
Taekyung suspects the Martial God may have been a System user and may be connected to the unknown voice; these remain unconfirmed.
Logout remains disabled following a System error. Taekyung wonders whether the restriction is connected to Xinjiang, without confirmation.

Dark Heaven’s stronghold in Xinjiang is showing unprecedented activity. More than thirty Hidden Shadow Pavilion agents are reported dead, contact has been lost, and the enemy may number more than a hundred thousand.
Taekyung and the Fire Dragon Pavilion have decided to head west. Their decision triggers a new Quest alert; its objective is unknown.
open_questions: Who was the unknown voice, and will Taekyung meet its owner?
Was the Martial God a System user, and is he connected to Cheon Taemin?
What did the Doppelganger mean by its final words, and what was it trying to accomplish?
